title: Ensure 'MSS: (DisableIPSourceRouting) IP source routing protection level' is set to 'Enabled: Highest protection, source routing is completely disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (DisableIPSourceRouting) IP source routing protection level to 'Enabled: Highest protection'
reason: Source routing allows the sender to dictate the routing path of a packet. This can be exploited to bypass network security controls.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (KeepAliveTime) How often keep-alive packets are sent in milliseconds' is set to 'Enabled: 300,000 or 5 minutes'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (KeepAliveTime) How often keep-alive packets are sent in milliseconds to 'Enabled: 300000'
reason: An attacker could create a denial of service condition by sending a large number of connection requests and never completing them. KeepAlive packets help drop dead connections faster.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (TcpMaxDataRetransmissions) How many times unacknowledged data is retransmitted' is set to 'Enabled: 3'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (TcpMaxDataRetransmissions) How many times unacknowledged data is retransmitted to 'Enabled: 3'
reason: Setting this threshold reduces the time the server waits for a dead connection to respond, mitigating certain DoS attacks.
